# BusinessDojo

> > BusinessDojo provides comprehensive business plan templates and Excel financial planning tools for entrepreneurs across diverse industries.

BusinessDojo specializes in ready-to-use business plan templates (.ppt, .pdf) and 3-year financial plans (Excel) featuring Provisional Income Statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow Statements, Break-Even Analysis, and Operating Performance Ratios. Created by the Dojo Business Team, these resources support funding requests, loan applications, and startup planning across service, retail, hospitality, and technology sectors.

## Key Topics

- Excel financial templates
- Business plan templates
- Financial projections
- Break-even analysis
- Provisional Income Statement
- Provisional Cash Flow Statement
- Provisional Balance Sheet
- Loan application preparation
- Funding requests
- Startup budget planning
- Working Capital Requirements
- Operating Performance Ratios
- Market research
- 3-year financial forecasts
- Entrepreneurship resources
